title: NEB Class 11 Chemistry — Stoichiometry — 2021
origin: curated NEB-pattern set filling the 2021 gap for class-11 stoichiometry

questions.solution:
Avogadro's law: equal volumes of all gases at the same temperature and pressure contain equal numbers of molecules.
At STP one mole occupies $22.4\,\mathrm{L}$, so $11.2\,\mathrm{L} = 0.5\,\mathrm{mol}$. Molecules $= 0.5 \times 6.022\times10^{23} = 3.011\times10^{23}$.
Molar mass of $\mathrm{CO_2} = 44\,\mathrm{g/mol}$, so mass $= 0.5 \times 44 = 22\,\mathrm{g}$.
questions.question: State Avogadro's law. How many molecules are present in $11.2\,\mathrm{L}$ of $\mathrm{CO_2}$ at STP, and what is its mass?

questions.solution:
Reduction half: $\mathrm{MnO_4^- \rightarrow Mn^{2+}}$. Balance O with water: $\mathrm{MnO_4^- \rightarrow Mn^{2+} + 4H_2O}$; balance H with $H^+$: $\mathrm{MnO_4^- + 8H^+ \rightarrow Mn^{2+} + 4H_2O}$; balance charge with electrons: $\mathrm{MnO_4^- + 8H^+ + 5e^- \rightarrow Mn^{2+} + 4H_2O}$.
Oxidation half: $\mathrm{Fe^{2+} \rightarrow Fe^{3+} + e^-}$ — multiply by 5.
Adding: $\mathrm{MnO_4^- + 5Fe^{2+} + 8H^+ \rightarrow Mn^{2+} + 5Fe^{3+} + 4H_2O}$. Atoms and charges ($+17$ each side) both balance.
questions.question: Balance the redox reaction by the ion-electron method: $\mathrm{MnO_4^- + Fe^{2+} \rightarrow Mn^{2+} + Fe^{3+}}$ (acidic medium).

questions.solution: Moles per 100 g: C $= 40/12 = 3.33$, H $= 6.7/1 = 6.7$, O $= 53.3/16 = 3.33$. Divide by the smallest (3.33): C:H:O $= 1:2:1$. Empirical formula $\mathrm{CH_2O}$.
questions.question: What is the empirical formula of a compound with 40% C, 6.7% H and 53.3% O by mass? (C=12, H=1, O=16)
